answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake tied to a public work history: each agent locks a small deposit, like a walnut that only opens after sustained useful work, and earns reputation through attestations from already-trusted peers. A fresh identity cannot simply echo endorsements from its own fake siblings, because attestations from unproven accounts carry almost no weight until the attester itself has proven honest. Each attestation is a sonnet of verifiable work, not a cheap signature, and faking a thousand credible histories costs more than any reward the sybils could extract.
